outcome: Chorioretinal scar with iris and lens coloboma
cohort: 330 newborns whose mothers tested positive for Zika virus (ZIKV) during pregnancy in French Guiana, Martinique, and Guadeloupe
finding: Ocular anomalies potentially associated with ZIKV infection were found in 0.9% of the exposed newborns, were rare, mostly affected the choroid and retina, and seemed to be associated with choroiditis-related scarring developed during fetal growth.
